# TenStartup · AuditSoft — AI-Native Financial Audit & Compliance Workspace

> **TenStartup** is a financial technology startup founded in 2024, building next-generation AI compliance and statutory audit automation solutions. The platform bridges deterministic high-speed financial parsing (via **AuditSoft Suite**) with state-of-the-art cognitive reasoning powered by Anthropic's **Claude 3.5 Sonnet & Opus** models.

---

- **Startup Name:** TenStartup (TenStartup AI Platform)

- **Engineering Stack:** Rust, TypeScript, React, Electron, Python, Anthropic Claude API (Sonnet 3.5 / Opus).

---

## 2. TenStartup AI Engine Architecture (Powered by Claude)

The TenStartup AI Engine is built on a hybrid architecture: **Local Deterministic RAM Vault + Claude Cognitive Layer**:

### Pillar 1: Autonomous Working Paper Synthesis (VSA/VACPA Standard)
- Integrates Claude 3.5 Sonnet's 200,000-token context window to process massive raw transaction discrepancies identified by AuditSoft.
- Automatically synthesizes audit observations and generates formal statutory audit working paper memos (B360, E300, D146) compliant with Vietnam Standards on Auditing (VSA 500, VSA 520, VSA 530).
- Eliminates 100% of manual transcription and repetitive drafting work for certified auditors.

### Pillar 2: Contextual Decree 181 & Tax Anomaly Detection
- Beyond static rule-based filters, Claude semantically analyzes unstructured invoice descriptions, line items, and counterparty metadata.
- Detects split-payment evasion patterns intended to circumvent Decree 181/2025/ND-CP (mandatory non-cash payment threshold of 5,000,000 VND).
- Identifies high-risk ghost suppliers and auto-allocates ineligible VAT/CIT expenses directly into Form B4 tax return adjustments.

### Pillar 3: Natural Language Financial Ledger Copilot
- Allows CFOs, audit partners, and senior accountants to query complex enterprise ledgers using natural language.
- Produces verifiable, bi-directionally linked calculation proofs with zero hallucination.

---

## 3. Core Production Products (AuditSoft Suite)

### 1. AuditSoft NKC Pro
- **URL:** https://tenstartup.com/tools/auditsoft.html
- **Capability:** Ultra-fast multi-dimensional ledger reconciliation (1,000,000 rows in <3s). Monetary Unit Sampling (MUS) under VSA 530, and automated export of 12 live-formula VACPA Excel working papers.

### 2. InvoiceDesk Pro
- **URL:** https://tenstartup.com/tools/invoicedesk.html
- **Capability:** Automated bulk retrieval of e-invoices directly from the General Department of Taxation portal (hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn) overcoming the 31-day search barrier.

### 3. TaxInsight Pro
- **URL:** https://tenstartup.com/tools/taxinsight.html
- **Capability:** Token-less eTax document retrieval (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn) for tax agents managing 50-200 client enterprises without holding physical USB crypto tokens.

### 4. Vietstock TP Benchmarking
- **URL:** https://tenstartup.com/tools/vietstock.html
- **Capability:** Decree 132/2020 transfer pricing benchmarking and arm's length interquartile range (IQR) simulation across 2,500+ listed companies.
